lines.text: Five Below keeps about 48¢ of every $5.
lines.say: Five Below keeps about forty-eight cents of every five dollars.

lines.text: That's operating profit: $457 million in fiscal 2025.
lines.say: That's operating profit: four hundred fifty-seven million dollars in fiscal twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: Sales more than doubled since fiscal 2019, to $4.76 billion.
lines.say: Sales more than doubled since fiscal twenty nineteen, to four point seven six billion.

lines.text: On average, a $5 sale leaves $1.80 after goods and rent, about 48¢ after everything else.
lines.say: On average, a five-dollar sale leaves one dollar eighty after goods and rent, about forty-eight cents after everything else.

lines.text: So it runs on volume: small stores, trendy stuff, teens and tweens.
lines.say: So it runs on volume: small stores, trendy stuff, teens and tweens.

lines.text: For 17 years, nothing cost over $5. Pricier items arrived in 2019, then Five Beyond in 2020.
lines.say: For seventeen years, nothing cost over five dollars. Pricier items arrived in twenty nineteen, then Five Beyond in twenty twenty.

lines.text: Why? At the same margins, a $15 item earns about $1.44, three times as much.
lines.say: Why? At the same margins, a fifteen-dollar item earns about a dollar forty-four, three times as much.

lines.text: In the quarter ended January 2026, same-store sales rose 15.4%.
lines.say: In the quarter ended January twenty twenty-six, same-store sales rose fifteen point four percent.

lines.text: Most items are still $5 and below; pricier ones grow the basket.
lines.say: Most items are still five dollars and below; pricier ones grow the basket.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: How Five Below keeps about 48 cents of every $5
post.ig:
Five Below keeps about 48 cents of operating profit per $5 of sales (our math: $457M / $4.76B).
Fiscal 2025 (year ended Jan 31, 2026): $4.76B net sales, $457M operating income, 36.0% gross margin.
Net sales grew from $1.85B in fiscal 2019.
Nothing cost over $5 until 2019; Five Beyond sections with pricier items followed in 2020.
Holiday quarter ended Jan 2026: comparable sales +15.4%.
Sources: Five Below fiscal 2025 results release (March 2026) and Form 10-K; Retail Dive (2021).
